node_purpose: Owner 2026-09-05 explicitly authorized continuing from the working single Agent toward multi-agent/full product and autonomously repairing ordinary defects, with sufficient DeepSeek funds. Execute one Q1 parallel Verifier/Counter review, at most one responsible original-author revision, then fresh parallel re-review. Not R12, not full-case acceptance.
input_scale_basis: Immutable R11 submitted workpaper and its 8 actual observations; 373342 pre-projection observation JSON characters and 16006 submission characters. No Codex content-review answers or hidden provider reasoning go to reviewers. Each role receives source artifacts in an isolated SDK conversation with the current approved data/tool scope.
required_outputs: responsible author revision if findings warrant
all model/tool usage and LangSmith trace
schema_burden: Existing Specialist agentic subgraph and five native tools per role, with review terminal substituted for author terminal. Standard LangGraph Send parallel evaluator/optimizer. Role-specific output templates validate only structured data, identity, anchors and references; natural-language semantics remain model review.
materiality_quality_risk: R11 runtime pass did not prove financial content. Do not supply the implementation author's known error list, hide failed reviews, promote candidate sources, rewrite S2 or manually repair the output. Any unresolved material/non-author-owner finding terminates with bounded handoff, not product PASS.
comparable_run_evidence: R11 single Specialist completed 7 real calls/8 data actions, 509224 cumulative tokens and 743.482s model time. Its final 16006-character workpaper and actual 373342-character observations define this review input. 215 targeted tests prove native review feedback, role-isolated SDK history, real reviewer MCP catalog, parallel barrier and repair/recheck contracts; real semantic quality remains unproved.
reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro thinking enabled for all three agent roles; private raw reasoning kept and continued only within each role invocation, with source artifacts/concise rationale used for cross-agent handoff. No automatic transport retry.
cost_and_latency_estimate: Measured R11 cost recomputation was about USD0.159, not an invoice. Two initial reviewers, one author revision and two re-reviewers are expected to require roughly 7-19 calls and USD0.5-3 at observed usage; actual cost/latency will be measured, not guaranteed. Hard per-node anomaly ceilings are 6 reviewer turns/8 tool actions and 12 author turns/16 actions; they are not completion targets. Owner states DeepSeek funds sufficient.

verifier.node_purpose: Independently inspect the complete original or revised Q1 workpaper, all material narrative assertions and observed source context; identify coverage, entailment, financial interpretation and language defects, then submit source/context-grounded findings without rewriting the report.
verifier.input_scale: R11 seed contains 8 observations, 373342 JSON characters before the existing semantic projection, and a 16006-character serialized workpaper with 11 claims. The shared SDK projection strips host metadata and starts a fresh role-isolated conversation; source content and all subsequent tool replies remain. Allow 500000 serialized input characters, including corrective history. No raw provider reasoning is handed to another agent.
required_outputs: Chinese findings or justified no-material finding
exact target revision and prose anchors
observed source references and concise source-context rationale
earliest responsible owner and actionable change
verifier.schema_burden: Five native tools; SubmitReviewAction replaces author submission. At most 24 findings with target quotes, reference/claim IDs, severity, category and concise rationale. Model judges semantics; local code only checks schema and anchors/identity/references.
verifier.materiality_quality_risk: Reviewer agreement is not a truth oracle or human acceptance. Check whole narrative against source context, not only declared claims; all failed revisions remain. No known Codex R11 finding list or target answer is injected.
verifier.comparable_run_evidence: R11 single Specialist completed 7 real calls/8 data actions, 509224 cumulative tokens and 743.482s model time.
